title: Annotatio VI §.III (2): Paschasius — repeatedly excepts Impious from body-participation
pass_a_gloss: Nor here is PASCHASIUS RADBERTUS to be passed in silence — whom some Lutheran theologians make the chief Patron of their opinion of Oral eating of Christ’s body without tearing by the teeth — expressly and more than once excepting those who communicate unworthily, i.e. the impious, from participation of Christ’s body. See above Annot. 2. §. 5.
pass_b_english: Paschasius Radbertus — whom some Lutherans claim as chief patron of Oral eating without teeth-tearing — must not be skipped.
He expressly and repeatedly excepts the unworthy (the impious) from participation of Christ’s body (see Annot. 2 §.5).
source_text: Nec hîc tacendus PASCHASIUS RHADEBERTUS, quem nonnulli Theologorum Lutheranorum, præcipuum sententiæ suæ de Orali corporis Christi manducatione citra dentium lacerationem, Fautorem faciunt, indignè communicantes i. e. impios à participatione corporis Christi disertè & plus semel excipiens. Vide suprà Annot. 2. §. 5.
